purpose: Exploratory initial RGB surface regions; not an independent benchmark annotation
selection_history: Chosen after observation_v1 and visual_v1; later outcomes were already inspected. Regions themselves use initial RGB only.
coordinate_convention: Zero-based u=column, v=row; xyxy rectangles are half-open
schedule: earliest geometrically eligible current frame, with deadline fallback to spend exactly 2 reads; no depth access before selection
claim_boundary: Contradiction of sampled initial surface support, not whole-object absence or localization success
